bias: He's on vacation Mon–Thu: this is the only daily plan until (maybe) Friday, no premarket update. 'Wild things tend to happen when I'm on vacation' — be prepared for volatility either direction. Both ES and NQ had a failed opening drive higher Friday after a huge NFP rip; 'perhaps we can forgive bulls their fatigue.' NQ matters most this week: a sustained break above Friday's high is a breakout until proven otherwise; anything else risks a false breakout. Big-picture warning: bonds got stuffed on a soft NFP, credit spreads and the MOVE index are moving — he is heavily cash / hedged.
wildcard: No premarket update this week — the overnight does its own thing with no one re-drawing the map. ES: a LAAF of Friday's high at 7815-22 followed by a loss of 80-84 makes a bearish engulfing of Friday's range 'reasonably likely.' NQ: a reaction in the 595-635 demand range that then reclaims Friday's low 'sounds a lot like a Pharm-is-on-vacation move.' Both have a bullish RTH gap from Thursday to Friday (ES 7741.25-7754, NQ 30906-30988) that is supportive on first test.

brief.happened: Failed opening drive higher, then balance between 7763-65 and 7780-84, leaving a failed distribution above 7790-91. That was after a 140-handle rip from Thursday's low to Friday's high (7810.25), so bulls get a pass on fatigue. Buyers notably struggled with 7780-84, which is September's VAH. Closed 7779. Two-way chop between 63-65 and 80-84 is the base case.
brief.pivot: 7780-7784 is the line (September VAH). 7763-65 is the floor of Friday's balance; 7790-94 is what bulls must firmly reclaim above. Friday's low 7754 sits on the 7747-54 weekly level with the Thu→Fri RTH gap (7741.25-54) under it.
brief.higher: Be cautious of failed reclaims of 7780-84 until 7790-94 is firmly reclaimed. Above 90-94, Friday's high 7810.25 should go for a test of 7815-22. If 7815-22 triggers a LAAF of Friday's high → 90-91 then 80-84 from above; back below 80-84 after that and a bearish engulfing of Friday's range becomes reasonably likely. Sustaining above 7815-22 (comfort above the 26-27 daily) → 7846-49, where it's continuation vs. LAAF.
brief.lower: LBAF of 63-65 → 80-84 (Friday's IB low 7773.5 is the honorable mention between). Absent that, Friday's low 7754 is in play — monitor for a LBAF of it, which targets 73.5 and 80-84 if 63-65 is reclaimed. 7740-41 (Thursday's spike) is the gap-fill reversal spot to reclaim Friday's low. Below that his lean is another liquidation break to 7706-12, with 7723-26 possibly slowing it. Below 7706-12 → 7678-81 and Thursday's low 7672.75; 7696-99 is a daily level in case the demand there triggers a reclaim of 7706-12.

brief.happened: Clear bearish build off a failed opening drive higher — but sellers didn't even reach 30951-69, let alone Thursday's high. Two new ATHs late in the week (Fri high 31282.5) while the week overlapped value lower. Afternoon balance between the 31125-43 weekly level and the low of day 30988. Closed 31070, right at the September high. 31056-69 sits in the middle of Friday's primary distribution but is too important to leave off.
brief.pivot: 31125-31143 above, Friday's low 30988 below with the critical 30951-69 right under it. The Wed/Thu highs cluster at 30869-30906 = the bullish RTH gap fill.
brief.higher: Cautious of a LAAF of 125-143 (up to ~156) that resolves to Friday's low or at least 056-069. A firm reclaim → 199-204; above that Friday's high in the 31269-88 range. Barring a fresh LAAF of Friday's high that gets back below 125-143, bulls are in control. Longs only with continuation above Friday's high; weekly first target 31527-45.
brief.lower: Monitor for a LBAF of Friday's low with 951-969 right there. Otherwise 869-906 can give a gap-fill reversal, which needs to reclaim Friday's low to see 056-069 and 125-143. If 869-906 doesn't hold, a liquidation break is possible (less certain than ES): 669-681 daily, then the whole 595-635 demand range (last week's VPOC 30625) — any reaction there needs Friday's low reclaimed. Thursday's low in 504-546 otherwise.
